title: Run MD compression simulations
action: Set up LAMMPS input scripts for Cu nanopillars with diameters 2, 3, 4, and 6 nm. Create an FCC Cu nanopillar with <111> orientation, fix end layers, and apply uniaxial compression at 300 K using the Cu EAM potential. Run the simulation and collect stress–strain data.
description: Generate stress–strain data via MD simulation; logs the simulation process.

title: Extract stress–strain data
action: From the MD simulation output, compute engineering stress and engineering strain for each diameter. Save the data as a JSON array covering the strain range 0.03–0.05 for each diameter.
description: Raw stress–strain curves for all diameters; the checker recomputes Young's modulus from this file.
output_schema: Array of objects with diameter_nm (number), strain (number), stress_GPa (number). Must include points covering strain 0.03–0.05 for each diameter.

title: Compute Young's moduli
action: For each diameter (2, 3, 4, 6 nm), perform a linear least-squares fit of stress_GPa vs. strain over the strain interval 0.03–0.05. The slope is the Young's modulus in GPa. Save as a JSON object mapping diameter to modulus.
description: Derived Young's modulus values for each diameter.
output_schema: JSON object with string keys '2', '3', '4', '6' mapped to numbers (Young's modulus in GPa).
